trends.name: Regional consolidation among mid-market security integrators
trends.rationale: Two separate acquisition announcements within 24 hours show established integrators (Securitas Technology, Pye-Barker) acquiring regional competitors to deepen geographic and operational capacity. Securitas acquired Sonitrol El Paso for Texas coverage on Oct 1, while Pye-Barker acquired Union AlarmTronic in New Jersey on Sep 30. This signals a pattern of market consolidation among mid-market players targeting adjacent service territories.

articles.title: Securitas Technology Announces Sonitrol El Paso Acquisition
Pye-Barker Acquires Springfield, New Jersey’s Union AlarmTronic

trends.name: Industry standardization efforts around OSDP protocol
trends.rationale: SIA and AMAG Technology announced a new tiered training program on Sep 24 specifically designed to educate sales and marketing professionals on OSDP (Open Supervised Device Protocol). This represents a formal industry-wide push to standardize knowledge and adoption of an open access control standard, indicating growing market momentum around protocol interoperability.

articles.title: SIA, AMAG Technology Launching New OSDP Training Program

trends.name: Strong industry attendance and economic activity at major security trade events
trends.rationale: GSX 2026 reported over 16,000 registrants from 100 countries and a 17% attendance increase over the prior year, generating over $30 million in regional revenue. This signals robust market health and continued investment in physical security solutions, with global participation indicating strong international demand.

articles.title: GSX 2026 Welcomes More Than 16K Registrants from 100 Countries
